description: The graph illustrates the similarity scores across different layers for four distinct configurations—en&en (red), en&es (blue), en&el (green), and en&bn (purple)—in the context of a multilingual expansion for large language models using a layer-wise mixture-of-experts approach. The x-axis represents the layer number, ranging from 0 to 23, while the y-axis shows the similarity metric, which ranges from 0.00 to 0.45. Each line corresponds to a specific configuration, with the red line (en&en) generally exhibiting the highest similarity values, peaking around layer 6 at approximately 0.26 and again sharply increasing after layer 21. The blue line (en&es) follows a similar trend but with slightly lower peaks, reaching about 0.25 at layer 6. The green line (en&el) and the purple line (en&bn) show lower similarity values throughout, with both peaking around layer 6 at approximately 0.15 and 0.14, respectively. All lines show a general decline in similarity from layer 6 to around layer 20, after which there is a sharp increase in similarity for all configurations starting from layer 21. This suggests a significant change in the model's behavior or representation at deeper layers, particularly after layer 21, where the similarity scores rise dramatically for all configurations.
